suggested_print_recipe.plate: Select the actual installed plate preset
suggested_print_recipe.temperature_and_speed: Use actual printer and filament preset defaults

models.name: Pocket tray
models.summary: A little landing spot for spare buttons, tokens and everyday bits.
models.notes: Print with the broad flat base on the plate and the opening facing up. Internal space is 91.2 x 59.2 x 14 mm. Not for food, liquids, hot objects or safety-critical storage.
models.customize: Change length and width for your space; keep the wall at least 1.6 mm and the base at least 1.2 mm.

models.name: Two-pen rest
models.summary: Two shallow channels to stop pens wandering across your desk.
models.notes: Print base down, channels facing up. Each open-ended channel is 15.4 mm wide; measure your pens first. This is a shallow rest, not a retaining clip or vertical holder.
models.customize: Adjust width for your pens. Channel width must remain at least 6 mm; there is no friction-fit promise.

models.name: Parts palette
models.summary: Three open compartments for sorting small craft parts as you work.
models.notes: Print base down with all compartments open upward. Each compartment is 32.8 x 55.2 x 12 mm. For dry, non-hazardous craft parts only, not paint solvents or food. Small parts are a choking hazard; keep away from children and pets.
models.customize: Change dividers from 0 to 4, then check the resulting shape and dimensions in your slicer.

models.name: Layer staircase
models.summary: A simple four-step shape for learning how layers become an object.
models.notes: Print the full rectangular base down, with the steps facing up. Each tread is 12 mm long and each rise is 4 mm. Inspect the layer slider in Bambu Studio to see the outline change. Educational object, not a certified calibration gauge or toy.
models.customize: Change step count from 2 to 8. Each tread must be at least 4 mm and each rise at least 1 mm.
